## Repository hygiene

- [ ] Read root `AGENTS.md`.
- [ ] One primary objective; unrelated changes excluded.
- [ ] No secrets, keystores, tokens, private payloads, user data or APKs committed.
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated when user-visible behavior changes.
- [ ] Documentation updated where required.
- [ ] No test/build/device result is claimed without evidence.
